utterances.speaker: JUDGE AGIUS
utterances.text: Yes. Good morning, Madam Registrar. Could you call the case, please.

utterances.speaker: THE REGISTRAR
utterances.text: Yes, Your Honour. Good morning, Your Honours. This is the case number IT-99-36-T, the Prosecutor versus Radoslav Brdjanin.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE AGIUS
utterances.text: I thank you. Mr. Brdjanin, good morning to you. Can you hear me in a language that you can understand?

utterances.speaker: THE ACCUSED
utterances.text: [Interpretation] Good morning, Your Honours. Yes, I can.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE AGIUS
utterances.text: I thank you. Please sit down. Appearances, Prosecution.

utterances.speaker: MR. NICHOLLS
utterances.text: Good morning, Your Honours. Julian Nicholls with Joanna Korner and Denise Gustin.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE AGIUS
utterances.text: Okay. Thank you, and good morning to you. Appearances for Radoslav Brdjanin.

utterances.speaker: MR. CUNNINGHAM
utterances.text: Good morning, Your Honours. David Cunningham with Barbara Baruch, we're assisted by Mr. Vojic.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE AGIUS
utterances.text: Any preliminaries.

utterances.speaker: MS. KORNER
utterances.text: Not in open session, Your Honour. There's one matter.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE AGIUS
utterances.text: We'll go into private session for a while, please.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE AGIUS
utterances.text: Now, with regard to tomorrow's witness, I would like you -- first of all, who will be leading?

utterances.speaker: MR. NICHOLLS
utterances.text: Mr. Koumjian.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE AGIUS
utterances.text: Mr. Koumjian. So may I ask you to be kind enough, Mr. Nicholls, to convey to Mr. Koumjian our message.

utterances.speaker: MR. NICHOLLS
utterances.text: Yes.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE AGIUS
utterances.text: That he ought to liaise with you, Mr. Cunningham.

utterances.speaker: MR. CUNNINGHAM
utterances.text: Yes, Your Honour.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE AGIUS
utterances.text: With Mr. Cunningham to agree on distribution of the time. I take it that Witness BT103 will be here for two days.

utterances.speaker: MR. NICHOLLS
utterances.text: That is the plan, Your Honour, yes.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE AGIUS
utterances.text: Between now and tomorrow we'll read the transcript of the interview, which we haven't had an opportunity to go through because it was only given to us this morning. And then more or less we should also be in a position to help you if you have a problem on the distribution of the time. Is there anything else you would like to raise before we adjourn? Is Mr. Ackerman all right?

utterances.speaker: MS. BARUCH
utterances.text: I'm hoping so, Your Honour.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE AGIUS
utterances.text: All right. No. I'm just asking as a matter of courtesy, and please convey to Mr. Ackerman our best wishes. So we'll resume tomorrow morning, 9.00, in this same courtroom, unfortunately. Thank you.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE AGIUS
utterances.text: a.m., to be reconvened on Wednesday, the 23rd day of July, 2003 at 9.00 a.m. 21 22 23 24 25
